blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Saturday accused the Philippine National Police (PNP) of serving as an “enforcement arm” of politicians, claiming that police officials had already prejudged allegations involving her former staff without conducting a thorough investigation.
